name: finance-control-multisurface
objective: Bind every required finance surface to current WLT/DSH contracts and prove one canonical end-to-end financial truth on one candidate.
truthOwner: WLT owns financial truth; DSH is bounded evidence/BFF; frontends are readback/action surfaces only.

tasks.objective: Regenerate/verify financial contracts and bind shared adapters/surfaces only to canonical WLT-backed routes.
tasks.currentProblem: Static screen/module presence does not prove current route/generated-client binding or canonical source ownership.
tasks.requiredChange: Regenerate/verify finance contracts, remove stale/local financial authority and bind all affected surfaces to canonical WLT-backed DSH/WLT routes.
tasks.targetState: Every finance read/action has one current contract and canonical backend source.
mustNotChange: Do not introduce local money truth.
Do not hardcode actor identifiers or operator context.
Do not restore obsolete payout semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: No local authoritative money calculation or hardcoded actor fallback.
Every required operation has current generated-client/route binding.
tasks.rollback: Revert surface wiring only; never re-enable stale financial authority as fallback.

tasks.objective: Complete permission/SoD-correct control-panel finance workflow and all four mobile finance states.
tasks.currentProblem: Current candidate lacks same-SHA proof for permission, blocked/reconciliation/offline/error states and masked financial presentation on all surfaces.
tasks.requiredChange: Expose only role-appropriate actions and canonical states, including new commercial/promotion/pricing/dispatch-finance states where relevant.
tasks.targetState: Every affected surface accurately reflects canonical WLT state and server authorization.
mustNotChange: Do not rely on UI-only authorization.
Do not expose raw official-wallet identifiers.
Do not show optimistic financial success before canonical readback.
acceptanceCriteria: Success is read back from canonical backend state.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation/action binding without changing canonical WLT state.

tasks.objective: Run one latest-head end-to-end finance closure matrix and bind every required check/review to that SHA.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical results target stale SHAs and include at least one required failure declared PASS.
tasks.requiredChange: Run fresh uncached static/backend/database/runtime/security/E2E/visual evidence after the last implementation write and re-pin the candidate.
tasks.targetState: One newest SHA carries all required passing evidence with no material finance exception.
mustNotChange: Do not waive required failures as unrelated without proven non-relevance.
Do not mark DONE before re-resolving remote head.
acceptanceCriteria: No unresolved material finance exception remains.
tasks.rollback: No closure rollback; any post-check write reopens evidence and requires re-verification.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final evidence/bookkeeping commit only after implementation is stable.
